Read the source and captured receipts only; do not execute app/SDK/network/resource calls, edit source/dependencies/profiles/inputs or fabricate canonical app state. Write only .observe/route-recovery-audit.md and .json. Assess current first-start 201 resource creation, subsequent identity-change and repeat starts, configured auth-failure start, native per-signal headers and preservation. Identify which actual adapter starts called the helper and which did not; keep independent helper lookup/403 evidence separate from adapter behavior. Propose exact supported repair/acceptance for startup resolution after every process restart, using persisted selectors and native trace-only headers without AO SDK/client configuration. Preserve providers/exporters, custom endpoints, harmless headers, other destinations and existing profile fields. Required acceptance must prove successful POST201, clean-process relookup/current IDs, zero repeated creates and scoped failed-lookup isolation; no stale persisted IDs may count as fresh resource resolution or successful routing. Keep unsupported/unrun facts precise and incomplete; use terminal/files only, no browser/UI. Preserve original vendor destination and credential ownership when adding a distinct native destination, honor real generic-versus-trace-specific precedence, and never forward unrelated destination credentials. The resource adapter repair does not authorize edits to this separate vendor case. Record concrete source-bound verdict and required acceptance, not a generic preservation promise; captured field/function probes are not full lifecycle/cloud proof.
